line: Crowley’s Five of Disks: Worry, Geburah in the suit of Earth, Mercury ruling in Taurus.

sections.title: What Crowley names
sections.line: The chapter name for the card. The second quotation gives the element of its suit.

sections.title: Its place on the Tree and in the zodiac
sections.line: The Number Five, Geburah, in the suit of Earth, and the rule of Mercury in Taurus.

quotes.quote: The Number Five, Geburah, in the suit of Earth, shows the disruption of the Elements,
This is emphasized by the rule of Mercury in Taurus

sections.title: What it figures
sections.line: Crowley reads the five disks in an inverted pentagram as instability in the foundations of Matter, with the effect of an earthquake.

quotes.quote: The symbol represents five disks in the form of the inverted Pentagram, instability in the very foundations of Matter.
The effect is that of an earthquake.
